# ONERA — DOTA, Optics and Associated Techniques

## Snapshot

| | |
|---|---|

| **City** | Palaiseau / Toulouse |

## Why it matters internationally

ONERA's DOTA department institutionalizes the optical-properties
measurement chain for French aerospace research: a dedicated laboratory
(MELOPEE) measures spectral and polarized optical properties of
materials, coatings, and paints, and the results are capitalized in the
MEMOIRES thermo-optical database that feeds infrared signature
modelling. For the emissivity community it is a reference for the
data-infrastructure face of radiative-property work.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** spectral reflectance · polarized optical signatures of coatings and paints · infrared signatures
- **Spectral range:** infrared detector characterization 1–20 µm; optical properties from visible to IR
- **Methodology:** Measurement of optical properties of materials at the MELOPEE laboratory (spectral and polarized signatures of coatings and paints); results capitalized in the MEMOIRES thermo-optical properties database; radiative-transfer code MATISSE for IR signature studies.

**Application domains:** infrared signature modelling (defense and aerospace) · coating and paint characterization.
